name: N°5
description: The aldehydic floral that defined modern perfumery: a bright, soapy sparkle over a bouquet of May rose and jasmine.

name: Coco Mademoiselle
description: A modern chypre: fresh citrus and rose laid over a clean, sheer patchouli.

name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Citrus and incense over smooth sandalwood. An everyday woody that works in almost any room.

name: Sauvage
description: Peppery Calabrian bergamot over a big, mineral ambroxan base. One of the best-selling fragrances of the decade.

name: J'adore
description: A golden, fruity floral bouquet built around jasmine and tuberose.

name: Fahrenheit
description: Violet leaf and a petrol-like leather accord. Divisive in 1988, a classic now.

name: Dior Homme
description: A powdery iris for men, softened with cocoa and dried down on vetiver and leather.

name: Shalimar
description: The archetypal amber: bright bergamot colliding with smoky vanilla.

name: L'Heure Bleue
description: Named for the blue hour of dusk in Paris: powdery, almondy and melancholy.

name: Vetiver
description: The reference vetiver: earthy, green and tobacco-tinged.

name: Black Opium
perfumer: Nathalie Lorson, Marie Salamagne, Olivier Cresp, Honorine Blanc
description: Black coffee and white flowers over vanilla. A night-out gourmand.

name: Libre
description: Lavender, the traditionally masculine note, set against sensual orange blossom.

name: Terre d'Hermès
description: Orange and mineral flint over vetiver: a fragrance about earth and sky.

name: Un Jardin sur le Nil
description: Green mango and lotus, inspired by the islands of the Nile at Aswan.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: Airy, mineral and sugared: saffron and amberwood with a burnt-sugar glow.

name: Black Orchid
description: Dark, earthy and opulent: black truffle and orchid over chocolate and patchouli.

name: Oud Wood
description: A polished, wearable oud that introduced the note to a Western audience.

name: Tobacco Vanille
description: Pipe tobacco and vanilla, like an old English gentlemen's club.

name: Santal 33
description: Australian sandalwood with a leathery, papyrus dryness.

name: Aventus
description: Smoky pineapple and birch. Famous for its batch-to-batch variations.

name: Green Irish Tweed
description: A green, grassy fougère evoking the Irish countryside.

name: Gypsy Water
description: Pine, incense and soft vanilla: a romantic take on a life lived outdoors.

name: Mojave Ghost
description: A soft, woody floral named after the ghost flower of the Mojave desert.

name: Philosykos
description: The whole fig tree: green leaves, milky fruit and sun-warmed bark.

name: Do Son
description: A breezy tuberose recalling summers on the Vietnamese coast.

name: Wood Sage & Sea Salt
description: Windswept and mineral: sea spray and sage on a clifftop walk.

name: English Pear & Freesia
description: Ripe pear wrapped in white freesia. The house's best seller.

name: Acqua di Giò
description: The aquatic that defined the late 90s: sea spray, citrus and warm skin.

name: Sì
description: Black currant nectar over a modern chypre base.

name: La Vie est Belle
perfumer: Olivier Polge, Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo
description: An iris gourmand: praline and vanilla lifted by pear and iris.

name: Angel
description: The first modern gourmand: patchouli and caramel in a star-shaped bottle.

name: A*Men
description: Angel's masculine counterpart: coffee, tar and caramel.

name: Flowerbomb
perfumer: Olivier Polge, Carlos Benaïm, Domitille Bertier
description: An explosion of sweet flowers in a grenade-shaped bottle.

name: 1 Million
perfumer: Christophe Raynaud, Olivier Pescheux, Michel Girard
description: Spiced leather and amber in a gold-ingot bottle.

name: Le Male
description: Barbershop lavender turned sweet with vanilla, in the famous torso bottle.

name: CK One
description: The shared scent of the 90s: clean citrus and green tea for everyone.

name: Youth-Dew
description: Launched as a bath oil so women could buy perfume for themselves.

name: Ambre Sultan
description: A resinous, herbal amber inspired by the souks of Marrakech.

name: Portrait of a Lady
description: A huge Turkish rose on a bed of patchouli and incense.

name: Carnal Flower
description: A photorealistic tuberose, green and creamy at once.

name: Colonia
description: The original Italian eau de cologne: bright Sicilian citrus and lavender.

name: Replica By the Fireplace
description: Roasted chestnuts and woodsmoke by a winter fire.

name: Candy
description: A benzoin-rich caramel, sweet but surprisingly airy.
